title: 第二十一章 万剑轮回，楚狂歌来访
content_zh:
天剑宗，后山禁地。

    一座古老的石门之前，无名太上负手而立。石门之上，镌刻着四个古朴苍劲的大字——万剑轮回。

    “此境，乃我天剑宗开派祖师所留，内蕴一方独立小世界，封印着历代先贤与上古剑修的残留意念与战斗印记。入其中者，需以神魂为引，以剑意为媒，与那些残留意念交锋，在生死之间感悟剑道真谛。”

    无名太上的声音平和，却带着一丝凝重：“此地凶险异常，稍有不慎，便可能神魂受创，甚至迷失其中，沦为只知杀戮的剑奴。以你如今的修为和心性，本不该如此早地进入此地。但……一月之期太短，非常之时，当行非常之法。”

    林墨看着那扇仿佛连通着另一个世界的石门，眼神坚定：“前辈放心，弟子定不负所望。”

    “进去吧。”无名太上不再多言，袖袍一挥，一股柔和的力道将林墨推向石门。

    嗡——

    石门表面泛起水波般的涟漪，林墨的身形没入其中，消失不见。

    眼前是无尽的灰白，仿佛混沌未开。

    下一刻，天旋地转。

    林墨发现自己站在一片无边无际的荒原之上。天空是铅灰色的，大地是暗红色的，到处插满了残破的剑器，弥漫着浓郁的血腥味和肃杀之气。远处，隐隐传来喊杀声、金铁交击声，以及一声声不甘的怒吼与悲鸣。

    “杀！”

    一道模糊的血色身影，手持一柄断剑，无声无息地出现在林墨身后，带着惨烈的杀意，一剑斩向他的后颈！

    林墨头也不回，身形如同柳絮般向前飘出，同时反手一剑！

    叮！

    剑光碰撞，那血色身影被震退数步，发出一声愤怒的咆哮，再次扑上！

    与此同时，周围的空间中，更多的模糊身影开始凝聚，他们有的身穿古老战甲，有的披头散发，有的只剩下半边身子……但无一例外，都散发着强大的剑意和浓烈的战意！

    这就是万剑轮回境！一个充满了上古战斗印记和残魂意念的杀戮之地！

    林墨深吸一口气，眼中没有丝毫畏惧，只有昂扬的战意。他握紧斩仙剑，主动迎了上去！

    叮叮当当！

    剑光交错，人影翻飞！林墨如同一叶扁舟，在狂风暴雨般的攻击中，艰难地辗转腾挪，寻找着反击的机会。

    这些战斗印记，虽然只是残魂意念，但生前至少都是道宫境以上的剑修，甚至不乏圣墟境乃至帝经境的强者留下的战斗烙印！他们的战斗经验和剑道感悟，虽然残缺不全，但对于林墨来说，却是最宝贵的磨刀石！

    他放弃了所有取巧的心思，将自己置于最危险的境地，用最原始的方式，去碰撞、去感受、去学习！
content_en:
Tianjian Sect, the forbidden area in the back mountain.

    In front of an ancient stone gate, the unknown Supreme Being stood with his hands behind his back. On the stone gate, engraved are four simple and vigorous characters - Ten Thousand Swords Reincarnation.

    "This realm is left by the founder of our Heavenly Sword Sect. It contains an independent small world, which is sealed with the remaining thoughts and battle marks of the sages and ancient sword cultivators. Those who enter it must use the soul as a guide and the sword as a mediator to confront those remaining thoughts and understand the true meaning of swordsmanship between life and death."

    The nameless Supreme Master's voice was calm, but with a hint of solemnity: "This place is extremely dangerous. If you are not careful, your soul may be injured, or even get lost in it, and become a sword slave who only knows killing. With your current cultivation and temperament, you should not have entered this place so early. But... the one-month period is too short, and in extraordinary times, you should do extraordinary things."

    Lin Mo looked at the stone door that seemed to connect to another world with firm eyes: "Senior, don't worry, my disciple will definitely live up to his expectations."

    "Go in." The Nameless Supreme Being said no more, waved his sleeves, and a soft force pushed Lin Mo towards the stone door.

    Buzz——

    Ripples like water appeared on the surface of the stone gate, and Lin Mo's figure submerged into it and disappeared.

    There is endless gray in front of me, as if chaos has not yet begun.

    The next moment, the world was spinning.

    Lin Mo found himself standing on an endless wasteland. The sky was lead-grey, the earth was dark red, and there were broken swords everywhere, filled with a strong smell of blood and a chilling air. In the distance, there were faint shouts of killing, the sound of gold and iron clashing, and a series of unwilling roars and lamentations.

    "Kill!"

    A blurry bloody figure, holding a broken sword, appeared silently behind Lin Mo. With a fierce killing intent, he slashed at the back of his neck with a sword!

    Lin Mo didn't look back, his figure floated forward like catkins, and at the same time he struck a sword with his backhand!

    bite!

    The sword light collided, and the bloody figure was knocked back several steps, let out an angry roar, and pounced again!

    At the same time, more vague figures began to gather in the surrounding space. Some of them were wearing ancient battle armor, some had disheveled hair, and some had only half of their bodies left... But without exception, they all exuded powerful sword intent and strong fighting intent!

    This is the realm of reincarnation of ten thousand swords! A killing place full of ancient battle marks and remnant soul thoughts!

    Lin Mo took a deep breath, there was no fear in his eyes, only high-spirited fighting spirit. He held the Immortal Killing Sword tightly and took the initiative to greet him!

    Ding-ding-ding-ding!

    The swords and lights crisscrossed, and the figures flew around! Lin Mo was like a boat, struggling to move around in the stormy attack, looking for opportunities to counterattack.

    Although these battle marks are just remnant soul thoughts, they were at least sword cultivators at the Dao Palace level or above during their lifetimes, and there were even battle marks left by strong men at the Saint Ruins level and even the Emperor Sutra level! Although their combat experience and swordsmanship knowledge are incomplete, they are the most precious whetstones for Lin Mo!

    He gave up all tricks, put himself in the most dangerous situation, and used the most primitive way to collide, feel, and learn!
title_en: Chapter 21 Ten Thousand Swords Reincarnate, Chu Kuangge’s Visit
